name: mcp-llm-offload
description: Offload light LLM work to a local model or any OpenAI-compatible provider, and delegate whole tasks to a Hermes bot.

llm_provider.title: Provider
llm_provider.description: lmstudio, ollama, llamacpp, openrouter, grok, openai, groq, together, deepinfra, mistral, hermes. Leave empty to decide automatically: a Hermes bot if you configure one below, otherwise LM Studio.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: single = send every job to the provider above. spread = split by cost: summarize/classify/extract/translate/rewrite go to the light backend, and ask/commit_message/pr_description/changelog/mock_data go to the heavy one.

light_provider.title: Light backend (spread only)
light_provider.description: Provider for cheap structured ops, e.g. lmstudio. Leave empty to use the provider above.

light_base_url.title: Light backend URL (spread only)
light_base_url.description: Only if the light backend is not on its default host, e.g. LM Studio on another machine: http://192.168.1.50:1234/v1

heavy_provider.title: Heavy backend (spread only)
heavy_provider.description: Provider for generation and judgement, e.g. hermes. Leave empty to use the provider above.

heavy_base_url.title: Heavy backend URL (spread only)
heavy_base_url.description: Only if the heavy backend is not on its default host. A Hermes bot is already covered by the Hermes gateway URL below.

fallback_provider.title: Fallback backend
fallback_provider.description: Tried when the main backend is unreachable, timing out, overloaded or out of quota — e.g. lmstudio as a floor behind a shared bot. Configuration errors like a bad key are reported as themselves, never retried elsewhere.

llm_model.title: Model
llm_model.description: Model id the provider serves, e.g. gemma-4-e2b-it. For a Hermes bot, use the bot field below instead.

llm_base_url.title: Base URL
llm_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint ending in /v1. Only needed to override the provider's default, e.g. LM Studio on another machine.

lmstudio_base_url.title: LM Studio URL
lmstudio_base_url.description: Where LM Studio actually is, if not on this machine, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:1234/v1. Needed for provider="lmstudio" to reach it on a per-call basis — the generic Base URL above only applies to the provider you made the default.

llm_api_key.title: API key
llm_api_key.description: Key for a hosted provider (OpenRouter, xAI, OpenAI, ...). Local backends need none.

hermes_base_url.title: Hermes bot gateway URL
hermes_base_url.description: The bot's OpenAI-compatible URL, ending in /v1, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8649/v1. Setting this makes the bot the default provider and enables task delegation.

hermes_bot.title: Hermes bot name
hermes_bot.description: Which bot runs the work — a Hermes profile name, e.g. github. Ask the agent server's `bots` tool if unsure.
